sentences.text:
The present application under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C. seeks anticipatory bail in case Fir No.
468/2022 under Sections 406/420/120- B/34 Ipc, registered at P.S. Mansarovar Park.

2.  The case of the prosecution is that complainant Rizwan who is running a firm namely Cash Lock Security Solution, dealing in scrap, was cheated in a premeditated manner by the accused persons and was made to part with a large sum of money.

It is the case of the prosecution that initially accused Naeem had fraudulently induced complainant to deposit a sum of Rs.8 lacs in the account of his firm namely, M/s Ansh Structure which was withdrawn by him.
Thereafter the accused Naeem introduced complainant to accused Jatin, owner of M/s JTC transport company.

The complainant was further induced to deposit an amount of Rs.29.50 lacs in the account of JTC Transport and was told that in case, the deal does not come through, he shall be returned the said money by cheque.

The Complainant also deposited a sum of Rs. 50,000 in the account of the accused Pawan Kumar,
out of which Pawan transferred Rs.25,000/- back to the account of the complainant.

Again, the complainant and co- accused persons, namely, Prashant,
Pawan, Sachin and one Kabira met in a hotel at Aerocity and kept the said DD in the locker of the hotel's room.
The said DD is stated to have been removed from the locker by accused Kabira and Sachin and the complainant only found a duplicate copy of the DD in the said locker of the hotel room 3.
The said DD was later deposited on 30.07.2022 in Aligarh Branch of Yes Bank which is a fake account created in the name of firm of the complainant.

The said account number ****7202 was opened in the name of the complainant and by accused Kallan and after encashment of DD, an amount of Rs. 29,49,000/- was immediately transferred in account no. ****0643 of ICICI Bank maintained in the name of Vaibhav Medical Store (of accused Vinod Kumar).
The said Vinod Kumar withdrew a sum of Rs. 29 lacs out of the said account and as such, complainant was cheated of the said amount.

4. It is also the case of prosecution that accused/applicant Prashant Bhati @ Satender Bhati @
Neetu Bhati further conspired with accused Kallan

It is the case that applicant/accused can also seen in the CCTV footage collected from ICICI Bank, Jyoti Nagar, Delhi alongwith accused Vinod Kumar after withdrawing the cash.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that main accused in the present case is the co-accused Pawan, as per the allegations made by the complainant, who has been chargesheeted without arrest.
It is further submitted that the investigation in the present case is complete.
The chargesheet and supplementary chargesheet have been filed.
The learned counsel for the applicant has placed on record the previous complaints made by the complainant wherein the allegations are with respect to co-accused Pawan, Sachin and Jatin.

6. Per contra, learned APP for the State submits that the submits that the applicant was seen in the CCTV footage of ICICI Bank alongwith co- accused Vijay, who was carrying the money after withdrawing it from the said account.
It is further submitted that the interrogation of the accused/applicant is, required with respect to money, which was being carried by the accused Vijay alongwith the present applicant.
It is further argued that the account in Yes Bank, Aligarh was opened with the active connivance of present applicant in the name of the fake firm.

7. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
8.

A perusal of the record reflects that the co-accused Vijay, who is allegedly to be seen in the CCTV footage carrying the money, has already been arrested and no recovery of money had taken place from the said accused.
The case of the prosecution in the chargesheet is that in the disclosure statement of the said co-accused it is stated that the money was given to co-accused Ram Kumar Prajapati.
The chargesheet has been filed on 22.11.2022 and a further supplementary chargesheet has also been filed in the present case.
10. In totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, the present application is allowed.

In the event of arrest, the applicant is directed to be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.
50,000/- with one surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer/Arresting Officer, further subject to following conditions:
i.
The applicant shall not leave the country without prior permission of the learned Trial Court.
ii. The applicant shall intimate the learned Trial Court by way of an affidavit and to the Investigating Officer regarding any change in residential address.
iii. The applicant shall appear before the learned Trial Court as and when the matter is taken up for hearing.
iv. The applicant shall join investigation as and when called by the Investigating Officer concerned.
v. The applicant will not try to influence the witnesses in any manner.
